name: github-plan-wiki
description: Create template-aware GitHub issues and pull requests with per-issue closing keywords, and publish approved plans to the GitHub wiki in English and Japanese.

interface.shortDescription: Template-aware issues, PR closure, and wiki plans
interface.longDescription: Turns approved plans into template-aware GitHub issue hierarchies and bilingual wiki pages, and creates or updates PR bodies with repository templates, a Fixed or Close keyword per completed issue, mandatory validation, and readback.
defaultPrompt: Break this approved plan into a parent issue and sub-issues with $github-plan-issues.
Publish this approved plan to the GitHub wiki with $github-wiki-plan.
Create a template-aware PR with per-issue closing keywords using $github-pull-request.
